author: Jenelle van Heerden
description: Scan-informed source PBR plant model; retain three complete LOD0 growth stages. This is not a claim that each whole plant is an untouched photogrammetry scan.

geometry.materialTreatment: Geometry-only export; exact original 8K source material channels are prepared separately, not silently dropped by default glTF conversion.

inactiveChannels.ao: Texture has no outgoing source link.
inactiveChannels.displacement: Group output is not connected to Material Output.

precision: Original 8192x8192 files unchanged. NormalGL and roughness are native HALF EXRs and decode/upload as HalfFloat, never via 8-bit image conversion.
axisAndNormals: Blender exact loop triangles and original split normals exported Y-up. Runtime shifts by actual basal root. All textures aligned to glTF top-origin UVs; native missing tangent attributes use the same normalScale.y=-1 correction as GLTFLoader.
translucency: Source alpha x translucency mask x 1.7 retains direct diffuse transmission; transmitted pigment uses source HSV saturation 1.3/value 1.1. Following the matched three-mode native D1 review, the candidate disables broad unoccluded additive indirect transmission while keeping existing reflected PBR/ambient light. All source maps remain bound; full R1/direct/reflected-only diagnostic modes are preserved. This is a documented Three.js approximation, not an exact Cycles equivalence.
stage: Canonical source/community candidate; no island approval
materialReview: work/living-v8/community-material-d1-root-review.md; community R2 complete native source art gate pending.

runtimePacking.scalarUploads: Original alpha G and translucency R planes, 8192 x 8192 unsigned 8-bit, lossless DEFLATE, R8 texture storage. Original sampled values and sampler/mips retained.
runtimePacking.halfUploads: Original normal RGBA16F and roughness R16F, identical DWAA HALF decode and top-origin row order, now performed by a cancellable worker with transferred buffers.
runtimePacking.nativeStatus: Integrated R2 main/shadow appearance and loading still require native review.
